messages:
Maya: Heads-up — need a quick sync on release gates for SI/integrator launches across H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi. Marketing wants concrete embargo windows + marketplace SKU readiness. What are the minimum signals we need to tell partners?
Liam: @Maya +1. We need a single canonical checklist. My view: firmware stable, driver validated on our runtime, CI pass on devimage, SKU tags in marketplace, and SI handoff doc.
Carlos: Agree with Liam. Also add thermal/power test signoff for B200 and Gaudi; SI ops have limited rack PDU margins.
Priya: For runtime validation add: perf regression <5% vs baseline, KV cache sanity, quantization smoke tests. Those are what runtime team needs to sign the gate.
Jade: Product: marketing needs embargo start/end for external comms and an internal freeze window (no feature toggles) — prefer a 48h freeze before announce.
Ellen: Legal: embargo windows must match NDA terms with vendor partners. We'll need a shared doc with explicit list of names/emails who can see prerelease assets.
Maya: Can someone draft a one-pager we can share with SIs and cloud marketplace teams? Ideally with machine-readable checklist and a short runbook for late-breaker firmware patches.
Liam: I'll stub a checklist in the repo tonight. Quick format idea: CSV-ish rows: signal, owner, required-by, verification-link. Example:
```
firmware_version, vendor_fw_team, -7d, https://staging/redwood/fw-signoff
runtime_ci_status, eng-runtime, -5d, https://ci.redwood/build/1234
marketplace_sku_tagged, partnerships, -3d, https://mp.redwood/sku/sku-abc
```
Carlos: @Liam add a column for "fallback policy" — e.g., if MI300 driver delayed, which model variant do we route to for Dedicated customers.
Priya: Also include a short test snippet for SI to run locally: `python -m rwinference.perf_test --model gaudi-1b --seq 512 --batch 4` and expected harness numbers (p50 latency < 45ms on B200 baseline).
Jade: For marketplace listing: need size of docker image, required tags (region available), and compliance flags (SOC2/ISO). Ops needs those to pre-create SKUs.
Ellen: Also note embargo exceptions: security hotfixes can be communicated earlier to named contacts only; include a secure distribution channel (S3 presigned + rotation).
Maya: Love this. Can we schedule a 30m with SIs + vendor PMs tomorrow 10am PT? Purpose: walk the checklist and confirm owners.
Liam: I'm available. I'll push the checklist draft to `partners/si-release-gate.md` and ping here when done.
Carlos: I'll prepare a short thermal/power test script and put expected pass/fail thresholds in the doc.
Priya: I'll add the perf smoke commands and a short troubleshooting section for KV cache mismatch.
Jade: I'll draft the embargo calendar + marketing copy windows and share the calendar invite once we settle the times.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar booking attempt failed due to conflicting vendor sync. Try alternate 11am PT or 2pm PT.
Maya: OK switching to 11am PT then. Final ask before the call — people add any hard blockers to the doc now so we can avoid surprises. I'll compile and send to partners right after the sync. :thumbsup:
Ellen: Adding legal checklist now — will flag any extra NDAs needed per vendor.
Maya: Thanks all — see you 11am PT.
